The systematic review’s findings pinpoint a set of contextual determinants—at organizational, community, and policy levels—that are positively linked to children’s and adolescents’ mental‑health service use. This directly maps onto hypothesis 3, whereas the other hypotheses describe specific interventions or modeling frameworks that go beyond the descriptive associations reported.
